correctness.rationale: For H_eff with the stated loss normalization, the rate of norm loss is κ times the boundary occupancy. The retarded boundary resolvent from site m is -(2/Ω)z^m/(1-iηz), where E=Ω[1-(z+z^{-1})/2] and |z|<1 above the real axis. Plancherel gives the two integrals: z=e^{ik} on the band and z=±q off it. This also checks the factors of two and that the objective is total eventual absorption. In RESULT.md proof steps 1–4 differentiation gives P'_m>0 for η≤1, both second derivatives strictly negative on [1,√3], and P'_m<0 on [√3,2] by comparing the bulk lower bound on -B' to 2/(3πη³). For η≥2 the elementary C'_2 formula has negative sign: g(2)>0 and g'=ηh with h(2)>0 and h'>0; weighting its integrand by the increasing q^{2(m-2)} at the one sign change preserves negativity. This proves the unique global crossing for every integer m≥2. Subtraction yields the positive reciprocal integral; the kernel's beta mass is asymptotic to m^-3. For C'_m(1), expanding (1+z)^-2 as (1+(1-z)+O((1-z)^2))/4 gives 1/(2πm³)+3/(4πm⁴)+O(m^-5). With B''(1)=-2/(3π) and C''_m=O(m^-2) uniformly near 1, the stationary displacement and the quadratic improvement give the stated two terms and 3/(16πm⁶).
